name: ai-sdlc
description: Research product ideas into intent and apply twenty reusable software delivery skills from any project.

interface.shortDescription: Research ideas and deliver software with evidence
interface.longDescription: Start with a rough idea, research relevant alternatives and constraints, and save the intent in your project. Includes specification, implementation, verification, review, release preparation and maintenance procedures.
defaultPrompt: Use $ai-sdlc:ai-sdlc-discover to research my product idea and draft its intent in this project.
